method: Exact path-string prefilter plus every imported Bingham/physical-time JSON; recursive parent-map reverse closure thereafter
reason: Path-string prefilter is conservative. Actual discovery requires exact original path AND current ROOT before SHA. Any prior pass at another hash necessarily resolves an unchanged archive; existing failures at other hashes cannot become newly broken. Reverse links use each old map before SHA. All immediate siblings of selected parents are then loaded explicitly.
